'''Buula's Raiders''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated out of [[Buula's Rocky Home]] and were led by [[Buula Nen]]. They had a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that was used to raid outposts and capture valuables and people. They would sell whatever they could, and ransom off their captives. If the prisoners weren't worth anything, they would be sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="H&S" />
